title: Minimalist Motivational Quote Poster (Ideogram)
description: Clean typographic motivational poster for Instagram, office wall art, and print-on-demand stores. Ideogram 2.0 excels at readable text.

prompt.main: minimalist motivational quote poster, large serif typography reading "STAY CURIOUS" in black, soft cream background, single small decorative line element below, generous white space, premium typographic poster design --ar 2:3
prompt.negative: busy, decorative, photo, cluttered, low contrast

explained.why: Ideogram's Typography style is purpose-built for text-heavy designs.
Ideogram 2.0 has dramatically better text rendering than 1.0.

tutorial.intro: Ideogram's superpower is text. Generic "quote poster" fails. The magic: put the actual quote in quotes.
steps: Format: minimalist motivational quote poster 鈥?format + purpose.
Typography: large serif typography reading "STAY CURIOUS" in black 鈥?the exact text in quotes.
Background: soft cream background 鈥?off-white is more premium than pure white.

tutorial.tips: Ideogram is the BEST at text rendering. Always use the actual text you want, in quotes, capitalized.

crossModel.midjourney: MJ v6.1: "minimalist quote poster, STAY CURIOUS, serif typography --ar 2:3 --v 6.1 --s 400".
crossModel.stable_diffusion: SDXL with controlnet. Ideogram is the only model that does text well out-of-the-box.
crossModel.flux: Flux is OK with text but inconsistent. Ideogram is best.
crossModel.dall_e: DALL-E 3: "A minimalist motivational poster with the text STAY CURIOUS in large serif typography on a cream background".

faq.a: Other models (MJ/SDXL/Flux) struggle with text. Use Ideogram for text-heavy designs.
Serif (Times, Garamond) = classic. Sans (Helvetica) = modern. Both work in Ideogram.
2:3 ratio, cream background, high contrast. Reads as "premium poster" instantly.
